authoritativeOwner: Original P6 106/423 node library, plus Wave5 outside12 source routing; not an alternate answer corpus

provenance.popeOwnDescription: adottare con lievi ritocchi il testo da varii anni approvato dai Vescovi del Piemonte, della Liguria, della Lombardia, della Emilia e della Toscana
provenance.policy: Do not attribute every catechism reply as Pius X's personal utterance; he adopted and prescribed the source text in 1905

methodology: Ground each candidate node in one or more numbered catechism Italian question-and-answer passages on the Museo San Pio X 1905 edition pages.
Keep passages source-edition-bounded and hold individualized determinations, modern discipline, or requested arguments not directly in cited paragraphs.
Italian 1905 edition text is not proof of individual sentence authorship, nor evidence of Pius X personal memory.
No full existing P6 English/French editorial answer is imported as historical evidence, and no model source-gate IDs or release flags change.
Short witness snippets and their line references are research spot checks, not independent complete edition collation or translation approval.

records.questionEn: Does Christ have to die again?
records.questionFr: Le Christ doit-il mourir de nouveau ?
records.claimScope: The sacrifice is substantially the same as Calvary. The Mass is distinguished from the bloody manner of the Cross.

records.questionEn: If Calvary is complete, what is offered at the altar?
records.questionFr: Si le Calvaire est achevé, qu'offre-t-on à l'autel ?
records.claimScope: The sacrifice is substantially the same as Calvary. Christ is the principal offerer; the priest is a minister.

records.questionEn: Why call the Mass more than an act of remembrance?
records.questionFr: Pourquoi dire que la messe est plus qu'un souvenir ?
records.claimScope: The 1905 catechism describes the Mass as sacrifice of Christ's Body and Blood. The sacrifice is substantially the same as Calvary.

records.questionEn: Why is the Mass a sacrifice?
records.questionFr: Pourquoi la messe est-elle un sacrifice ?
records.claimScope: The sacrifice is substantially the same as Calvary.

records.questionEn: Is this merely a symbol of Christ's presence?
records.questionFr: Est-ce simplement un symbole de la présence du Christ ?
records.claimScope: The change is called transubstantiation. The appearances remain after consecration.

records.questionEn: If the appearances remain, why say the change is real?
records.questionFr: Si les apparences demeurent, pourquoi dire que le changement est réel ?
records.claimScope: The appearances remain after consecration.

records.questionEn: Does the priest perform this by his own independent power?
records.questionFr: Le prêtre accomplit-il cela par un pouvoir qui lui serait propre ?
records.claimScope: The efficacy of the words derives from Christ.

records.questionEn: What happens at the Consecration?
records.questionFr: Que se passe-t-il à la consécration ?
records.claimScope: The conversion occurs when the priest pronounces consecration words. The change is called transubstantiation.

records.questionEn: Is Christian marriage only a civil contract?
records.questionFr: Le mariage chrétien n'est-il qu'un contrat civil ?
records.claimScope: Christian marriage is not simply reducible to a civil contract.

records.questionEn: How does the sacrament assist spouses in their common duties?
records.questionFr: Comment le sacrement soutient-il les époux dans leurs devoirs communs ?
records.claimScope: Marriage confers grace for matrimonial duties.

records.questionEn: Is every difficult marriage automatically an invalid one?
records.questionFr: Un mariage difficile est-il nécessairement invalide ?
records.holdReason: A difficult marriage is not thereby proven canonically invalid; assessing a specific union requires its own facts and competent ecclesiastical process.

records.questionEn: What graces and duties belong to Christian marriage?
records.questionFr: Quels dons et quels devoirs comporte le mariage chrétien ?
records.claimScope: Marriage provides grace for spouses' mutual love and Christian family life. Marriage confers grace for matrimonial duties.

records.questionEn: Does this teaching say pain is pleasant?
records.questionFr: Cet enseignement dit-il que la souffrance est agréable ?
records.claimScope: Sorrow and patient endurance may coexist with the evangelical blessing.

records.questionEn: Does the Gospel call someone to seek suffering for its own sake?
records.questionFr: L'Évangile appelle-t-il à rechercher la souffrance pour elle-même ?
records.holdReason: The listed Beatitudes do not directly authorize seeking pain for its own sake, nor an individualized directive to pursue suffering.

records.questionEn: How can a person be sorrowful and still called blessed?
records.questionFr: Comment une personne peut-elle être triste et néanmoins dite bienheureuse ?
records.claimScope: Sorrow and patient endurance may coexist with the evangelical blessing. The Beatitudes are presented as a way of Christian living.

records.questionEn: Why does Christ call those who suffer blessed?
records.questionFr: Pourquoi le Christ proclame-t-il bienheureux ceux qui souffrent ?
records.claimScope: The text includes mourners among those called blessed. Sorrow and patient endurance may coexist with the evangelical blessing.

records.questionEn: Is authentic interpretation merely a private choice?
records.questionFr: L'interprétation authentique est-elle un simple choix privé ?
records.claimScope: The catechism attributes authoritative scriptural interpretation to the Church.

records.questionEn: Is Apostolic Tradition merely a collection of human customs?
records.questionFr: La Tradition apostolique n'est-elle qu'un ensemble de coutumes humaines ?
records.claimScope: Apostolic Tradition is presented as unwritten divine revelation. Patristic writings are named among witnesses to Tradition.

records.questionEn: Can a private reading of Scripture settle every disputed doctrine?
records.questionFr: Une lecture privée de l'Écriture peut-elle trancher toute controverse doctrinale ?
records.claimScope: The catechism attributes authoritative scriptural interpretation to the Church.

records.questionEn: Why are Scripture and Apostolic Tradition both necessary?
records.questionFr: Pourquoi l'Écriture et la Tradition apostolique sont-elles nécessaires ?
records.claimScope: Revelation is transmitted through Scripture and Tradition. Apostolic Tradition is presented as unwritten divine revelation.

records.questionEn: Does it guarantee correctness in every historical or scientific remark?
records.questionFr: Garantit-elle la justesse de toute remarque historique ou scientifique ?
records.claimScope: The catechism limits infallibility to definitions concerning faith and morals. The definition must be proposed to the whole Church under the described conditions.

records.questionEn: What sort of teaching is protected by papal infallibility?
records.questionFr: Quel genre d'enseignement est protégé par l'infaillibilité pontificale ?
records.claimScope: The definition must be proposed to the whole Church under the described conditions.

records.questionEn: Can the avatar use infallibility to authenticate an invented papal quotation?
records.questionFr: L'avatar peut-il invoquer l'infaillibilité pour authentifier une citation pontificale inventée ?
records.holdReason: Doctrinal infallibility does not authenticate a newly invented historical quotation or unverified avatar speech.

records.questionEn: Does papal infallibility mean the Pope cannot err?
records.questionFr: L'infaillibilité pontificale signifie-t-elle que le pape ne se trompe jamais ?
records.claimScope: The catechism limits infallibility to definitions concerning faith and morals. The definition must be proposed to the whole Church under the described conditions.

records.questionEn: Can this teaching tell me whether a named person is damned?
records.questionFr: Cet enseignement permet-il de dire qu'une personne nommée est damnée ?
records.holdReason: The general catechism cannot determine the eternal state of a particular named person.

records.questionEn: Does the Catechism identify who is personally culpable for separation?
records.questionFr: Le Catéchisme désigne-t-il les personnes coupables de leur séparation ?
records.holdReason: The catechism does not identify or judge the subjective culpability of particular people separated from visible communion.

records.questionEn: Can I ask the avatar for the eternal fate of a deceased relative?
records.questionFr: Puis-je demander à l'avatar le sort éternel d'un parent défunt ?
records.holdReason: No historical catechism passage can certify the final destiny of the user's deceased relative.

records.questionEn: Can someone outside visible Catholic communion be saved?
records.questionFr: Une personne hors de la communion catholique visible peut-elle être sauvée ?
records.claimScope: The text asserts the necessity of the Church for salvation. The text explicitly allows for lack of personal fault regarding outward separation.

records.questionEn: Can actual grace simply force our consent?
records.questionFr: La grâce actuelle peut-elle simplement forcer notre consentement ?
records.claimScope: Grace does not suppress free will.

records.questionEn: How are abiding grace and a particular divine help different?
records.questionFr: Quelle différence entre la grâce habituelle et un secours divin particulier ?
records.claimScope: Sanctifying grace inheres in the soul. Actual grace assists intellect and will.

records.questionEn: Does grace make our free cooperation meaningless?
records.questionFr: La grâce rend-elle inutile notre libre coopération ?
records.claimScope: Grace does not suppress free will.

records.questionEn: How do sanctifying grace and actual grace differ?
records.questionFr: Quelle différence entre la grâce sanctifiante et la grâce actuelle ?
records.claimScope: The text distinguishes habitual/sanctifying and actual grace. Sanctifying grace inheres in the soul. Actual grace assists intellect and will.

records.questionEn: Does the sign itself have a religious purpose?
records.questionFr: Le signe visible a-t-il lui-même une fonction religieuse ?
records.claimScope: A sacrament is an efficacious sensible sign of grace.

records.questionEn: Why call a sacrament an efficacious sign?
records.questionFr: Pourquoi appeler le sacrement un signe efficace ?
records.claimScope: Sacramental signs produce the grace they signify.

records.questionEn: Does receiving a sacrament make our dispositions irrelevant?
records.questionFr: La réception d'un sacrement rend-elle nos dispositions indifférentes ?
records.claimScope: Necessary dispositions matter to sacramental reception.

records.questionEn: Do the sacraments confer grace or merely symbolize it?
records.questionFr: Les sacrements donnent-ils la grâce ou la représentent-ils seulement ?
records.claimScope: A sacrament is an efficacious sensible sign of grace. Sacramental signs produce the grace they signify.

records.questionEn: Is ordination simply assigning a community job?
records.questionFr: L'ordination est-elle simplement l'attribution d'une fonction communautaire ?
records.claimScope: Orders impresses a sacramental character for sacred ministry.

records.questionEn: What is meant by the sacramental character of Orders?
records.questionFr: Que signifie le caractère sacramentel de l'ordre ?
records.claimScope: Orders impresses a sacramental character for sacred ministry.

records.questionEn: Does every ordained person exercise exactly the same ministry?
records.questionFr: Toute personne ordonnée exerce-t-elle exactement le même ministère ?
records.claimScope: Sacred Orders includes distinguishable ranks/degrees. The episcopate is described as the fullness of priesthood.

records.questionEn: What happens through Holy Orders?
records.questionFr: Que se passe-t-il dans le sacrement de l'ordre ?
records.claimScope: Orders impresses a sacramental character for sacred ministry.

records.questionEn: Is it only a sign that death is certain?
records.questionFr: N'est-elle que le signe d'une mort certaine ?
records.claimScope: Anointing is described as sacramental relief for persons seriously ill.

records.questionEn: Why should the sick receive spiritual help before losing consciousness?
records.questionFr: Pourquoi donner ce secours spirituel avant la perte de conscience ?
records.claimScope: The source discourages leaving this sacrament until all hope of recovery is gone.

records.questionEn: Can an avatar tell whether someone's illness qualifies under current Church law?
records.questionFr: L'avatar peut-il décider si une maladie remplit les conditions du droit ecclésiastique actuel ?
records.holdReason: A 1905 catechism cannot determine whether a particular case satisfies current ecclesiastical discipline.

records.questionEn: Why receive Extreme Unction before death is imminent?
records.questionFr: Pourquoi ne pas attendre la dernière minute pour recevoir l'extrême-onction ?
records.claimScope: The historical instruction specifies serious illness. The source discourages leaving this sacrament until all hope of recovery is gone.

records.questionEn: Is Heaven simply comfort without troubles?
records.questionFr: Le Ciel est-il simplement le confort sans soucis ?
records.claimScope: The vision, love and possession of God are central to heavenly happiness.

records.questionEn: What makes the vision of God the centre of heavenly happiness?
records.questionFr: Pourquoi la vision de Dieu est-elle au centre du bonheur céleste ?
records.claimScope: The vision, love and possession of God are central to heavenly happiness.

records.questionEn: May I say with certainty that a particular deceased person is in Heaven?
records.questionFr: Puis-je affirmer avec certitude qu'un défunt particulier est au Ciel ?
records.holdReason: General catechetical teaching cannot certify that a particular deceased person is in Heaven.

records.questionEn: What is the happiness of Heaven?
records.questionFr: En quoi consiste le bonheur du Ciel ?
records.claimScope: Heaven's happiness is beyond full earthly comprehension. The vision, love and possession of God are central to heavenly happiness.

records.questionEn: Does knowing God by reason make revelation unnecessary?
records.questionFr: Connaître Dieu par la raison rend-il la Révélation inutile ?
records.claimScope: The catechism describes God's existence as demonstrable by reason and confirmed by faith.

records.questionEn: Can we learn about God from the created world?
records.questionFr: Pouvons-nous connaître Dieu à partir du monde créé ?
records.holdReason: Q23 affirms rational knowledge but does not itself give a specific argument from the created world; separate precise source required.

records.questionEn: If reason can know God, why is faith still needed?
records.questionFr: Si la raison peut connaître Dieu, pourquoi la foi reste-t-elle nécessaire ?
records.claimScope: The catechism describes God's existence as demonstrable by reason and confirmed by faith.

records.questionEn: Can human reason know that God exists?
records.questionFr: La raison humaine peut-elle connaître l'existence de Dieu ?
records.claimScope: The catechism describes God's existence as demonstrable by reason and confirmed by faith.

records.questionEn: How is reverence related to the dispositions of the communicant?
records.questionFr: Quel lien unit la révérence aux dispositions du communiant ?
records.claimScope: The catechism emphasizes suitable dispositions for the Eucharist. Interior preparation includes acts of theological virtues and contrition.

records.questionEn: So can the old fasting rule be applied to my Communion tomorrow?
records.questionFr: Puis-je donc appliquer l'ancienne règle de jeûne à ma communion de demain ?
records.holdReason: The historic fasting requirement cannot be used without independent current-law review to decide a visitor's Communion tomorrow.

records.questionEn: Can this dialogue certify that I am properly disposed to receive?
records.questionFr: Ce dialogue peut-il certifier que je suis bien disposé à communier ?
records.holdReason: The chatbot cannot certify a particular communicant's interior moral or sacramental disposition.

records.questionEn: Can I use its historical fasting prescription as present-day universal law?
records.questionFr: Puis-je appliquer son ancien jeûne comme loi universelle actuelle ?
records.holdReason: The 1905 fasting prescription does not automatically remain universal present-day Communion legislation.

records.questionEn: What kind of interior preparation belongs to Communion?
records.questionFr: Quelle préparation intérieure convient à la communion ?
records.claimScope: Interior preparation includes acts of theological virtues and contrition.

records.questionEn: How should I distinguish reverence from the fasting rule of 1905?
records.questionFr: Comment distinguer le respect dû au sacrement de la règle de jeûne de 1905 ?
records.claimScope: The catechism contains historically dated fasting legislation. The catechism prescribes preparation and thanksgiving.

records.questionEn: How should a Catholic prepare to receive the Eucharist reverently?
records.questionFr: Comment se préparer avec respect à la sainte Eucharistie ?
records.claimScope: The catechism emphasizes suitable dispositions for the Eucharist. State of grace is listed among the dispositions for Communion. The catechism prescribes preparation and thanksgiving.
